fields.value: Results-driven Business Analyst with 12+ years of experience in Investment banking and Capital markets, adept at bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. Knowledge in working across Agile and Waterfall methodologies to deliver high-impact projects in trade lifecycle management, regulatory compliance, and derivatives operations. Skilled in requirements gathering, stakeholder management, root cause analysis, and process optimization. Strong domain expertise in Otc Derivatives, trade processing, and collateral management, with ability to manage cross-functional teams and deliver value-driven outcomes.
Ebix Miles Software Solutions Pvt Ltd.
Experienced Business Analyst focused on promoting team efficiency and adaptability with proactive cross functional communication and meticulous attention to details.
Managing clients across MEA region with Revenue over $50M & over by providing White Glove support.
Analyzed business requirement and identified solutions resulting in 25% cost reductions.
Gathered Business requirement using BRD & got LOA signed from clients. Collaborated with Testing team & conducted RCA for enhancing process efficiency.
Collaborating with cross functional teams to implement process changes, improving efficiency by 30%.
Excellent analytical skills with ability to transform the needs of business users in to functional requirement.
Extending support to Testing & Development team periodically by getting status updates on deliverables & bridging gap by communicating the deployment plan schedule effectively.
Received Appreciation from Internal & External stakeholders for taking ownership in delivering & managing scoping of work within timeline along with client retention.
Associate Team Leader, Product Support BA
Managed Portfolio Management Software (PMS) as Product Support BA for top-tier hedge fund clients based globally, with revenues exceeding $1 billion trading in Derivatives, Equity & F.I.
Collaborated with Global Stakeholders, Portfolio Managers, Global Account Management teams to troubleshoot technical queries related to entire Trade Life Cycle for Equity & Fixed Income products.
Generated revenue by implementing client requested features on PMS Application and gained cost approvals from Implementation team & cross selling products by liaising with sales team.
Managed the onboarding of new clients on PMS platform by proactively setting up data related to Fund, Accounts, Counterparty & reference data information on PMS Application.
Managed the surveillance of Rates OTC trading activities by handling escalations of high-value transactions and enhancing process efficiency through diligent risk management.
Updated and maintained process SOPs documents by ensuring adherence across the team and contributing to continuous process improvement.
Optimized Manual recs by Automation for avoiding manual interventions to attain quality, reduce errors & timely deliverables.
Proactively reviewing if the contracts are updated in system before the timeline & received multiple recognition from clients and senior management for managing contracts.
Initiated MIS reports and dashboards for senior management on Tableau Application.

Transitioned an Equity Trade control Middle Office Process from the US Shared Services Office to the local Market Operations, ensuring meticulous Intersystem Reconciliation for FOBO and Reporting to cover risk, regulations, and control measures.
Improved the operations of banking services by refining reconciliation procedures, which heightened the precision of reports for derivatives and fixed income securities.

Implemented the uploading of manual reconciliations on Internal system with automation by reducing manual input, and enhancing the quality and punctuality of deliverables for Hedge Funds clients based in the US & EMEA region.
Served as the Independent POC in audits for a Tier one client, effectively managing audit expectations and supplying auditors with the required valid documentation within deadline.
Assisted the Sales Support role involved managing the collateral charged to counterparties by the bank and handling the associated data within the Murex Application.
Engaged in the Interest Rate Swap Process for Lehman Brothers by scrutinizing derivative transactions for their validity and compliance, and raising any discrepancies to the attention of clients.
